draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.89, the 199th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 29th of 36 at WR. He went 105th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (199th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: J.J. Nelson. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (99th percentile). College production: 1,054 receiving yards in 2025, 4th of 36 WRs in his class with stats.
